newsitem.title: USA: Waigel comments add to dlr/mark losses in late US.
newsitem.headline: Waigel comments add to dlr/mark losses in late US.

text.p: *Dollar slips to 1.79 marks after German Fin Min Waigel says cabinet to endorse strong mark, euro Wednesday. Profits taken above 1.80, accelerated as Buba Zeitler said rally overshot.
*Dlr/yen pressured on dollar/mark slippage, but regains 115.50.
*Traders report little fear of official mark buying, though multiple German comments recently raise prospect above 1.80.
